text:
sara: Thanks for joining today's all-hands infra update — following up here with the Q&A items from the GPU / regions / autoscale segment. I'll capture open action items so we can track. TL;DR: APAC GPU pool targeted for Q3 (tentative), autoscaler regional-burst feature goes into canary next week, Dedicated reservations beta planned for June. Slides + perf matrix linked below.

devin: quick q — for APAC provisioning, are we standardizing on H100s or mixing in L40s? app teams need perf numbers to decide model variants.

lia: short answer: mix. we've prioritized H100 for low-latency route capacity and L40s for high-throughput/cheap-batch workloads. slide 12 has perf curves. H100 procurement timing is the driver here (vendor lead times vary).

mike: for Dedicated customers — when can sales start taking reservations for eu-west dedicated pools? need a concrete calendar date.

rajee: can we implement an automatic regional fallback policy? ex: route to eu if apac saturated but maintain a cost cap/fallback priority so teams don't explode billing.

lia: autoscaler update — we're adding a "regional-burst" flag that allows cross-region short bursts up to a pct of capacity. timeline: canary deploy Tue, validate Thu, full rollout Fri next week. example config snippet:
```
autoscaler:
  regionalBurst: true
  maxBurstPct: 25
  fallbackPolicy: ["region","tier","model-variant"]
```

devin: when cross-region routing happens, is KV/prefix cache preserved or do teams pay cold-start penalty? that's the big latency concern.

lia: if the same model+version exists in target region we preserve customer prefix cache for identical runtime; otherwise it's a cold start. recommendation: set sticky routing for latency-sensitive endpoints and enable regionalBurst for cost-tolerant jobs.

infra-bot: Slides uploaded: https://redwood.s3/all-hands/2026-03-infra-slides.pdf ; perf matrix: https://redwood.s3/all-hands/perf-matrix-2026-03.csv

sara: action items I'm tracking: 1) Lia -> post canary checklist + rollback steps (due Mon EOD) 2) Sales & Mike -> confirm EU dedicated reservation start date by Wed 3) Procurement -> confirm H100 vs L40 allocation and ETA by Fri EOD. Ping me if I missed anything.

mike: I'll sync with Sales and loop in contracts — assigning rep now.

devin: noted, thanks! :thumbsup:
